title: Construct exact Gaussian corrections with pruned and mixed precision circuits
body:
PR5813 identified Gaussian bulk precision savings but left the exceptional correction as a dense Walsh factorization with no complete delivery bill. This package supplies exact arbitrary-input correction algorithms, their full precision and storage costs, and an actual native-recipe match. It does not claim a new numerical kappa.

The spectral correction is implemented by a pruned Walsh gather and its literal transpose: O(N log(t+1)) coordinate incidences instead of Nt separate dense incidences. A Gaussian Newton-remainder theorem proves every exceptional coefficient divisible by pi^(R+1), including negative offsets. The algorithm pays its true p+2n-R-1 working precision, multiplier heights, exact final quotient and owned cleanup. A coefficient-valuation prefix schedule further prunes precision without assuming favorable masks.

An alternative all-output circuit uses the explicit integral Smith factorization C=S diag(1,pi^2) T for C=[[i,1],[1,i]]. Its tensorized triangular passes preserve every output, with no assumed exceptional cache or input symmetry. The new whole-pass theorem bounds addition-precision mass between N[np+n(n+1)/2] and N[np+n(n+1)/2+n], versus nN(p+n) at fixed modulus. The sharper excess is at most Nn exp(-p^2/(2n)); at p=n the exact ratio is (3n+1)/(4n). These expectations count all coordinate labels, not a random-input promise. Phases, shifts, routing, copies, initialization, storage and erasure remain charged.

The current native compiler's C gate is exactly the normalized Gaussian axis. Its actual right/left monomial sandwich identifies the lifted central primitive as A_(rf), with true absolute phase and spectators. Both source-preserving calls and in-place MOVE are covered: the latter has an explicit fully charged exact forward/swap/inverse-clean adapter. Immutable source versions, unequal numerator tags, backwards demands and all original helper/dirty endpoints are retained. A generic common Fourier gauge is not presumed; the supplied patch compiler charges every actual boundary.

The exceptional algebraic response is closed constructively, but the whole all-size time inequality remains open. With n=rf and p=Theta(f), the literal Smith word still has Theta(2^(rf)f^2) addition-operand mass, an input-bit-length times log(input-bit-length) scale. A better leading precision coefficient alone does not prove a positive kappa. No new histogram, solver/experimental result, operator/caller/invoice replay, Lean audit, supplier admission or selected-frontier change is claimed. All five existing framework assumptions remain.

One coordinator and three workers developed and independently cross-reviewed these informal proofs. The selected main record remains .00310045 with admitted BIT .0034; the strongest inspected pending claim remains PR5811 .00312418633064. Canonical main is de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a, priority8. Recent PR and accessible handoff/proposal Discussion coverage was refreshed; exact source pins and limits are in SOURCES.md. PR5814's new signed-query tape interface is a separate scope. The released four accumulations are not credited again.

Seven notes are added only under research/gaussian-exceptional-correction. Start with assembly-and-invoice.md A1-A5, then correction-algorithm.md and consumer-construction.md. Open next questions focus on a real shared bank, a fully priced commuting patch and fewer growing-width passes. No favorable unknown decoder or cache is assumed in the proved algorithms.

Credit OpenAI's pinned preprint architecture; PR5813's Gaussian spectral bridge; Ali Romman's native/hub/accumulated source chain; Joel Pulikkan/GamingPuzzled's protected block; Dugongue's prior composition; Mason Hale's fourth accumulation; ToikY, flyingviper, Pierre-Loic Doulcet/hexapode, Cinna Davis, David Arias, Gareth Davidson, Cao Yifan, DaysSky, Nick Petalas, Ryanson Jonathan, Jacob Alan Sussman, zxv and all retained source/native/controller/compiler/ownership/BIT/precision/analytic contributors. Classical component facts retain their attribution. New text is Apache-2.0 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
